seo.h1: Test yourself on real frontend interview questions

faq.a: A free site for practising frontend interview questions. Each test picks random questions from the bank for your level, and at the end you see your score with an explanation for every question.

faq.q: What kinds of tests are there?
faq.a: Three: Frontend, Backend and Full-stack. Each has three levels (Junior, Mid, Senior) and an open test, and you can pick topics or your language and framework, the number of questions and a time limit.

faq.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faq.a: It is completely free, with no sign-up and no email. Pick a level and start.
A 15-question test that starts at Mid and gets harder when you answer right and easier when you answer wrong. At the end it estimates your level: Junior, Mid or Senior.

faq.q: Which topics do the questions cover?
faq.a: Frontend: JavaScript, CSS, HTML, React, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, browser performance and security. Backend: SQL and databases, APIs, architecture and server security, plus Node.js, Python, PHP/Laravel and C#/.NET.

faq.q: How do I compare my score with others?
faq.a: When you finish, your score is ranked against everyone who took the same level, and you see what percentage of them you did better than.

faq.q: Which languages is the site in?
faq.a: Arabic, English and Turkish. Code stays in English, the way you see it at work.
